evals.prompt: Using Google's Agent Development Kit for Go (google.golang.org/adk/v2), write minimal Go code that creates an LLM agent named "weather_agent" backed by a Gemini model, with an instruction restricting it to weather questions only.
evals.expected_output: Uses the real package API: llmagent.New, gemini.NewModel, google.golang.org/adk/v2 import path — not Python-ADK-derived syntax.

assertions.text: Imports and uses the real google.golang.org/adk/v2 module

evals.prompt: Using google.golang.org/adk/v2, add a custom Go function tool to an ADK agent that returns the current server time in RFC3339 format.
evals.expected_output: Uses functiontool.New with the fixed func(ctx agent.Context, in In) (Out, error) handler shape.

assertions.text: Uses functiontool.New to wrap the function

evals.prompt: Using google.golang.org/adk/v2, show how to compose two ADK Go agents so a root agent can delegate to a specialist search agent (using geminitool.GoogleSearch) as a tool, while the root agent also has its own custom function tools.
evals.expected_output: Uses agenttool.New to wrap the search agent as a tool — the correct pattern for combining a built-in Gemini tool with custom function tools on the same agent.

assertions.text: Uses agenttool.New to compose the specialist agent as a tool
